name: SRE
summary: Investigates operational issues across the platform and proposes fixes through GitHub pull requests.

flow.title: Readiness event
flow.detail: Alloy collects Kubernetes Events into Loki.

flow.title: Grafana alert
flow.detail: Grafana alerts on repeated readiness failures by cluster and namespace.

flow.title: Foundry agent
flow.detail: An operator submits scoped evidence to the Entra-authenticated Foundry endpoint.

flow.title: Diagnosis
flow.detail: The agent returns a structured diagnosis and trace ID.

components.name: Hosted runtime
components.detail: A versioned Microsoft Foundry container serves the Invocations API. The Python adapter delegates to the shared agent runtime.

components.name: Model access
components.detail: The bounded-agent policy uses scoped reasoning, coding, and embedding connections through the shared LiteLLM gateway.

components.name: Monitoring and evidence
components.detail: Grafana evaluates readiness alerts using Loki Events. Evidence is supplied on demand.

components.name: Notes and knowledge
components.detail: Caller-scoped notes and checkpoints support ongoing investigations. Reviewed runbooks provide context for retrieval.

components.name: Telemetry
components.detail: OpenTelemetry can export investigation traces with model and tool spans to the shared collector.

components.name: Delivery and evaluation
components.detail: The shared CI workflow builds and scans the image. Native Foundry deployment, exact-version hosted replays, and context checks validate release candidates.
